info.name: Leave Management System - Complete API Collection
info.description:
Microservices Leave Management System - All API Endpoints with End-to-End Flows

Base URL: http://localhost:5000 (via API Gateway)

Pre-seeded Users:
- employee1/password123 (Employee, reports to manager1)
- employee2/password123 (Employee, reports to manager1)
- manager1/password123 (Manager)
- manager2/password123 (Manager)

Run 'End-to-End Flows' folder in order for complete workflow testing.

item.name: 7. End-to-End Flow: Success Scenario
item.description:
Complete happy path - Run these requests IN ORDER.

1. Employee logs in
2. Checks balance
3. Applies for leave
4. Manager logs in
5. Views pending requests
6. Approves leave
7. Employee checks notifications
8. Employee verifies updated balance

item.name: 8. End-to-End Flow: Rejection Scenario
item.description:
Complete rejection flow - Run IN ORDER.

1. Employee applies for leave
2. Manager rejects it
3. Employee gets rejection notification
4. Balance is restored
